en.headline: Hong Kong women beat Brazil 29-24 with last-play penalty try
en.dek: Hong Kong China won their WXV Global Series Challenger opener at Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground after a penalty try in the final play.
body: Hong Kong China’s women’s fifteen beat Brazil 29-24 on Sunday in the opening round of the WXV Global Series Challenger at Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground, after being awarded a penalty try on the last play of the match.
South China Morning Post reported that the penalty try gave Hong Kong the lead for the first time in the contest. Sky Sports listed the result as Hong Kong Women 29, Brazil Women 24.

The series, hosted in Hong Kong from 13 to 26 September, also opened with Fiji’s 38-32 comeback win over Spain and a 70-0 victory for the Netherlands against Samoa. Hong Kong next play Fiji on Saturday 19 September at the same venue.

Hong Kong China Rugby has said the Challenger results feed into the pathway towards the 2029 Women’s Rugby World Cup. The union had described Sunday’s home fixture as the team’s first home Test since 2024.

zh.headline: 港隊女欖末陣罰球達陣 29比24挫巴西
zh.dek: 中國香港女子十五人欖球隊周日在啟德青年運動場揭幕戰末陣獲判罰球達陣，29比24擊敗巴西。
body: 中國香港女子十五人欖球代表隊周日在啟德青年運動場出戰WXV全球系列挑戰賽揭幕戰，憑完場最後一攻獲判罰球達陣，29比24擊敗巴西。
《南華早報》報道，該記罰球達陣是港隊全場首次領先。Sky Sports賽果亦列港隊29分、巴西24分。
系列賽由9月13日至26日在港舉行。同日另兩場賽事，斐濟38比32反勝西班牙，荷蘭則以70比0大勝薩摩亞。港隊下一場將於9月19日（周六）在同一場地迎戰斐濟。
中國香港欖球總會早前表示，今次挑戰賽成績與競逐2029年女子欖球世界盼席位有關，並指周日主場賽事是港隊自2024年以來首場主場測試賽。
